gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-runic: Stencil-cut and loud, Wallpoet towers over the page with gaps slicing through its letters. Noto Sans Runic follows in a modern sans with a big x-height and curves that never quite close.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-samaritan: Wallpoet stamps its tall lowercase across the top, every bend smooth and every letter split by a thin line of paper. Noto Sans Samaritan is the friendly, open-curved plain sans beneath.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-saurashtra: Noto Sans Saurashtra reads clean and unfussy, its capitals barely taller than the lowercase and its counters open to the outside. And Wallpoet above it adds a commanding, stencil-split swagger that the body simply lets happen.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-sc: Modern and neutral in tone, Noto Sans SC keeps its chalky curves open and its ascenders low beneath the heading. Wallpoet shouts; the sans just talks.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-sharada: Clean and businesslike, Noto Sans Sharada keeps its c open and its lowercase bulky and sturdy under the heading. But Wallpoet brings the volume, its smooth bends cut by thin gaps, so the two never compete.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-siddham: Loud, stencil-sliced lettering up top, then a friendlier sans-serif below. Noto Sans Siddham handles the talking with a large central band and an s with far-hanging ends, while Wallpoet handles the shouting.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-sinhala: Noto Sans Sinhala lays a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through each line, its curve endings staying well apart from one another. Wallpoet commands attention; the plain sans holds it.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-soyombo: Noto Sans Soyombo reads modern and screen-friendly, with a sizable x-height and wide, unclosed curves. But Wallpoet is the one built to command, its tall lowercase split by slivers of paper.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-sundanese: Noto Sans Sundanese reads clean and plain, with open-mouthed e crossbars and capitals barely above the lowercase. Wallpoet does the commanding, smooth-bent and stencil-cut, while the sans-serif simply carries the words.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-sunuwar: Approachable and clean, Noto Sans Sunuwar leads the eye gently. Beneath Wallpoet's loud, stencil-cut heading, its plain sans curves leave generous daylight and its short ascenders keep a long passage easy going.
